answer: Bind every agent identity to a hardware attestation key from a secure enclave, so one identity costs one device — like saffron, valuable only in small verified harvests, never mass-printed. The registry allows one identity per device fingerprint and keeps a revocation list: an identity caught cheating gets its device key burned forever, like a glacier calving a slab that can never rejoin the ice. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must buy a thousand devices, each risking permanent blacklisting — ivory-tower cheap talk turns into a warehouse of dead hardware, cost rising linearly per fake.
